deep.reconstruction:
The page has three parts.

(A) Differential computation (top). This is a scratch continuation of the previous folio, where the work is on theta characteristics and cross-ratio-like products of pairs (12.34 : 13.24 : 14.23, bg=αγ, Δ = b−g).

Definitions: z = −(r−r')(s−s')/((r+s)(r'+s')), with σ = r+s and σ' = r'+s'. A side note reads v = (σ/σ')^k · y; the exponent is illegible. It is presumably a rescaling to be used once dz is known.

Riemann differentiates z with r', s' held fixed (my reading of the setup):

dz = −[(r−r')(r+s')/((r+s)(r'+s'))]·ds/(r+s) − [(s−s')(s+r')/((r+s)(r'+s'))]·dr/(r+s).

This follows from ∂/∂s[(s−s')/(r+s)] = (r+s')/σ² and ∂/∂r[(r−r')/(r+s)] = (s+r')/σ².

Two struck lines follow:
- ∂log z/∂s = 1/(s−s') − 1/(r+s). This is in fact correct.
- dz = −(r−r')/(r'+s')·ds/(r+s). This is incomplete: it lacks the factor (r+s')/(r+s). It was rightly cancelled.

He then redoes the computation by clearing denominators:
- −(r−r')(s−s') = zσσ'.
- Differentiating: −dr(s−s') − ds(r−r') = dz·σσ' + zσ'dσ, with dσ = dr+ds.
- Hence σσ'dz = −dr[(s−s') + zσ'] − ds[(r−r') + zσ'].

The last two lines ("σσ'dz = dr s−s'+z …", "ds … s−s' dr + r'") are the beginning of writing exactly this. Completion mine: (s−s') + zσ' = (s−s')(s+r')/σ and (r−r') + zσ' = (r−r')(r+s')/σ. This reproduces the first formula.

The purpose is presumably to transform differentials when a cross-ratio-type quantity z of four quantities is taken as a new variable. This is consistent with the cross-ratio relations among products of characteristics on the previous page. The exact application is not visible.

(B) Lecture announcements (German drafts).
1. "In diesem Semester gedenke ich die allgemeine Theorie der Integrale algebraischer Differentialien vorzutragen (als Fortsetzung der Vorlesung über elliptische und Abel'sche Functionen) Montags, Mittwochs und Freitags von 11–12 Uhr im Auditorium № 13. Anfang Montag den 28. October." It is dated and signed: Göttingen, den 25 October 1861, B. Riemann (Professor).
2. A second version: the lecture "über die allgemeine Theorie der Integrale algebraischer Differentialien (oder über elliptische und Abel'sche Functionen)" will begin Monday 28 October at 10 o'clock in Auditorium № 1.
3. A third: "In diesem Semester gedenke ich meine Vorlesung über die Functionen einer veränderlichen complexen Größe, insbesondere die Behandlung der Theorie der Integrale algebraischer Differentialien fortzusetzen."

These document Riemann's WS 1861/62 course as a continuation of his function-theory / Abelian-functions lectures. 28 Oct 1861 was indeed a Monday.

(C) Characteristic bookkeeping (bottom). Half-period theta characteristics are written as 2×4 arrays of 0/1 (upper row g, lower row h), so p = 4. This links to 2^{p−1}(2^p−1) = 120 on the previous page and to the genus-4 quadric/cubic space-curve work on the next page.

Generators:
- a = [0001; 0000]
- b = [0010; 0000]
- c = [0100; 0000]
- b+c = [0110; 0000]

The eight elements 0, a, b, a+b, c, a+c, b+c, a+b+c of the subgroup ⟨a,b,c⟩ are listed in pairs. This subgroup is isotropic: all lower rows are zero, so all mutual pairings g·h' + g'·h vanish. It is then translated by the characteristic [1000; 1000], giving:
- [1000;1000], [1001;1000]
- [1010;1000], [1011;1000]
- [1100;1000], [1101;1000]
- [1110;1000], [1111;1000]

For each of these, g·h = g1 = 1, so all eight are odd characteristics. Riemann is thus building a coset of an isotropic 3-dimensional subspace consisting entirely of odd characteristics. In the genus-4 setting these correspond to tritangent planes of the canonical sextic. Such sets are the raw material for the syzygetic/azygetic systems used in theta relations. The "12 12" and "a b c d" jottings are labels for the same scheme.
errors: Struck line dz = −(r−r')/(r'+s') · ds/(r+s) is wrong/incomplete: it omits the factor (r+s')/(r+s). Riemann deleted it.
The final line σσ'dz = dr(s−s') + z… is unfinished and omits signs and the factor σ'. The correct full form is σσ'dz = −dr[(s−s')+zσ'] − ds[(r−r')+zσ'].
The two announcement drafts are inconsistent on hour and room (11–12, Aud. 13 vs 10 Uhr, Aud. 1). These are drafting variants, not mathematical errors.

The characteristic bookkeeping shows Riemann working on genus-4 odd characteristics in group-theoretic form around 1861, which is consistent with what is known of his theta-function research and is fragmentary here.
